answer: Each identity must pass a bandwidth-relay test: every 12 hours a verifier sends a 4 MB payload and the node must return it within 800 ms, which needs a dedicated 25 Mbps link. Each pass adds a thread to a public uptime record, and pooled hosts on one river of shared bandwidth show a latency delta. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 links (25,000 Mbps), while an honest user pays for one, so cost grows linearly. Verifiers re-time 10% of relays; a failure slashes the 30 POA deposit and freezes the crystal-clear nectar payout.
